about: [C2] The jank walk (WAVE_C §7.5) on the test bed, by real input (W held into each thing): the desk on its side, a living man standing (held still), a dead man on the floor, a shut door, a locked door, a wall. Nothing passes through anything: after each walk the eye is outside what it walked into. And the lean: down beside a doorway with the wall before me (too tall to rise over), RMB leans the eye out round the jamb, and back. node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/guns_walk.json

steps.name: the title, BEGIN at the test bed
the room: the men gone; one standing held still, one dead on the floor; every door shut, the corridor's locked

steps.eval: (() => { for (const h of [...G.world.hoods.list]) G.removeHood(h); const house = G.stage.part('house'); for (const d of Object.values(house.doors)) { d.set(0); d.locked = false; } house.doors.BD.locked = true; G.guns.covers.rebuild(); const hold = (h) => { const ai = G.ais.get(h); ai.brain.S.state = 'watch'; }; window.MAN = G.guns.spawn({ kind: 'pistol', at: { x: -3.0, z: -1.6 }, wait: 1e9, yaw: 0 }); hold(window.MAN); window.DEAD = G.guns.spawn({ kind: 'pistol', at: { x: -3.2, z: -6.2 }, wait: 1e9 }); hold(window.DEAD); return 'ok'; })()
(() => { const h = window.DEAD; G.killHood(h, new N.THREE.Vector3(0, 0, -1), false, 'deathKnees'); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: into the desk on its side (from behind it, toward the door)

steps.eval: (() => { const m = window.MAN; N.controller.setPose(m.pos.x, m.pos.z + 2.2, 0, -0.1); N.controller.setMode('gun', { crouch: false }); return 'ok'; })()

steps.label: a living man: not through him

steps.name: into the dead man on the floor

steps.eval: (() => { const c = G.guns.corpses[0]; N.controller.setPose(c.x + 2.0, c.z, -Math.PI / 2 * -1, -0.3); const yaw = Math.atan2(-(c.x - G.eye.x), -(c.z - G.eye.z)); N.controller.setPose(c.x + 2.0, c.z, yaw, -0.3); N.controller.setMode('gun', { crouch: false }); return [c.x, c.z]; })()

steps.expect: (() => { const c = G.guns.corpses[0]; return Math.hypot(G.eye.x - c.x, G.eye.z - c.z) > 0.4; })()
steps.label: a body on the floor: walked round, not through

steps.name: into the shut door to the corridor

steps.label: a shut door: it stays shut, I stay this side

steps.name: the locked back door: E rattles it

steps.eval: (() => { const d = G.stage.part('house').doors.BD; d.locked = true; N.controller.setPose(-0.4, -6.8, 0, -0.05); N.controller.setMode('gun', { crouch: false }); return 'ok'; })()

steps.label: a locked door: it rattles and holds

steps.name: the lean: down beside the corridor's doorway, the wall before me (too tall to rise over), RMB: the eye out round the jamb

steps.eval: window.E0 = { x: G.eye.x, z: G.eye.z, y: G.eye.y }

steps.expect: Math.abs(N.controller.leanK) > 0.8 && Math.hypot(G.eye.x - E0.x, G.eye.z - E0.z) > 0.35 && G.eye.y - E0.y < 0.4
steps.label: too tall to rise over: the eye leans out round the jamb
